English: Choose the international trade term that defines delivery point, risk transfer, and cost responsibility (e.g., FOB, CIF, EXW).
Bahasa Indonesia: Pilih ketentuan perdagangan internasional yang menentukan titik pengiriman, perpindahan risiko, dan tanggung jawab biaya (misalnya FOB, CIF, EXW).

Location: Quote Create/Edit — Terms and Conditions section
English: Select the mode of transportation for goods delivery (e.g., Air Freight, Sea Freight, Land Courier).
Bahasa Indonesia: Pilih moda transportasi untuk pengiriman barang (misalnya angkutan udara, laut, atau kurir darat).

Location: Quote Create/Edit — Terms and Conditions section
English: Enter the estimated time frame for delivery or completion after order confirmation.
Bahasa Indonesia: Masukkan perkiraan waktu pengiriman atau penyelesaian setelah pesanan dikonfirmasi.

Location: Quote Create/Edit — Terms and Conditions section
English: Define the agreed process to resolve disputes, such as arbitration, mediation, or court settlement.
Bahasa Indonesia: Tentukan proses yang disepakati untuk menyelesaikan sengketa, seperti arbitrase, mediasi, atau penyelesaian melalui pengadilan.

Location: Quote Create/Edit — Terms and Conditions section
English: Indicate the legal jurisdiction or country law that governs the agreement.
Bahasa Indonesia: Tentukan yurisdiksi atau hukum negara yang mengatur perjanjian.

Location: Quote Create/Edit — Terms and Conditions section
English: Include a clause to protect both parties if contract obligations cannot be met due to events beyond control (e.g., natural disasters, war).
Bahasa Indonesia: Sertakan klausul untuk melindungi kedua pihak jika kewajiban kontrak tidak dapat dipenuhi karena kejadian di luar kendali (misalnya bencana alam atau perang).

Location: Quote Create/Edit — Terms and Conditions section
English: Apply financial penalties or interest charges when payment is delayed beyond the agreed term.
Bahasa Indonesia: Terapkan denda atau bunga jika pembayaran terlambat melewati jangka waktu yang disepakati.

Location: Quote Create/Edit — Terms and Conditions section
English: Require the supplier to provide assurance of product quality or project completion as agreed.
Bahasa Indonesia: Wajibkan pemasok memberikan jaminan kualitas produk atau penyelesaian proyek sesuai kesepakatan.
